root_cause: The Growth Swarm catalog contained twenty plays, but production readback showed only thirteen ACTIVE; seven remained ARMED or READY_FOR_SURFACE. This meant the catalog could overstate execution completeness.
decision: Complete the seven missing trigger-to-executor paths and preserve the existing Persuasion Revenue Optimizer in the canonical commercial cycle.

runtime_evidence.email_note: No qualifying email action existed at the activation instant; the executor remains autonomous and gate-bound.

prevention: Never equate catalog presence with implementation completeness.
A growth play is ACTIVE only when it has trigger, decision, executor/surface, outcome metric and truth/privacy gates.
A persuasion recommendation is not terminal when a safe executable action exists.
Preserve the existing Persuasion Revenue Optimizer and autonomous asset/outbound lineage instead of creating a parallel system.
No sensitive psychographic profiling, fake scarcity, fake social proof, fabricated benchmarks or unsupported financial impact.
evidence: Production runtime readback: 20 Growth Swarm plays ACTIVE out of 20 catalog entries.
Initial Persuasion decision materialization created 8 decisions.
Growth action executor routed an eligible SEO/problem action into canonical content execution.
No external email was forced when no action passed evidence, cooldown and suppression gates.
Production readback after merge: 20 ACTIVE / 20 catalog, 8 active persuasion decisions, 10 persuasion principles, one canonical commercial scheduler and zero parallel Growth Play schedulers.

terminal.execution_truth: Eligible actions execute through canonical providers; ineligible actions wait/nurture rather than forcing contact.
